body: src/archetype.h + src/archetype.c: 6 archetypes (TYLER/EMILY_S/EMILY_OS/CAMERA_OP/VALENTINA/JIANGSHI) with natal data, Hz frequency, layer, mode, prompt prefix. archetype_classify() perplexity scoring. --archetype NAME CLI flag steers generation with prefix. --classify scores text against all archetypes and prints ranked results. --list-archetypes prints the table. title: Add archetype engine: TYLER universe character voice steering and classification for GPT-2
